historical_commentary.text: This note describes the internal byte-level structure of 4D's records within its data files, aimed at helping developers optimize data access and understand 4D's inner workings, including general database-architecture tradeoffs (one file per table plus per-index files versus a consolidated format). Because 4D's on-disk record and data-file format has been re-engineered multiple times in the decades since (v11 SQL engine, then the 64-bit engine), the specific byte-level structure detailed in this note no longer matches any current 4D file format, making it a historical snapshot of early 4D internals rather than a practical reference.
